description: This file defines functions and types for configuring query builder components related to routing forms and attributes, including dynamic operand handling, field configuration, and attribute transformation.

methods.name: getQueryBuilderConfigForFormFields
methods.description: Generates configuration for form fields in a query builder, optionally for reporting purposes, including handling of field types and operators.

methods.name: getQueryBuilderConfigForAttributes
methods.description: Creates configuration for attribute-based fields, supporting dynamic operand fields and attribute options.

methods.name: transformAttributesToCompatibleFormat
methods.description: Transforms attribute objects into a format compatible with the query builder, mapping attribute types to field types.

methods.name: isDynamicOperandField
methods.description: Checks if a string matches the pattern for a dynamic operand field.

methods.name: buildDynamicOperandFieldVariable
methods.description: Constructs a dynamic operand field variable string given a field ID.
